title: Recruitment Rules To be Notified Within Month, Chief Secretary Tells GMC Staff

ai.summary: Protesting non-gazetted employees at five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir have demanded service recruitment rules be notified within a month, following a Chief Secretary's assurance after nine days of indefinite protest.

facts.claim: Protesting non-gazetted employees at five new Government Medical Colleges in Jammu and Kashmir have demanded service recruitment rules be notified within a month
facts.quote: The employees are demanding immediate finalisation and notification of service recruitment rules for all five newly established Government Medical Colleges — GMC Rajouri, GMC Doda, GMC Kathua, GMC Handwara and GMC Baramulla — including a clearly defined service structure, promotion mechanism, designations, eligibility criteria, seniority arrangements and promotional hierarchies for various categories of staff.

facts.claim: following a Chief Secretary's assurance after nine days of indefinite protest
facts.quote: Chief Secretary Sajjan Singh Yadav on Tuesday assured protesting non-gazetted employees of Government Medical College (GMC) Rajouri that their long-pending service recruitment rules would be notified within a month, following an intervention after employees stopped his cavalcade during his maiden visit to the district.

ai.background_note: The protest involves non-gazetted employees at five new Government Medical Colleges established across Jammu and Kashmir, demanding service recruitment rules that have been pending for nearly seven years.
